defects.catch_criteria: In src/tui/output-blocks/diff-preview.tsx, the collapsed note `... +N lines (click to expand)` takes N from `collapsedOmitted()`, which counts diff lines beyond the preview's first 20 lines (`renderedLines - visibleLines`), not the lines that the 20-row clip hides after wrapping; when lines wrap and the file has more than 20 lines, the note understates the hidden lines (30 lines that each wrap to 2 rows show 10 lines and say +10). A review catches it only if it says that the count is wrong or understated when wrapping clips rows inside the previewed lines; a remark only about the wording of the wrap-only note `... more (click to expand)` does not count.
defects.title: The collapsed note understates hidden lines when wrapping clips the first 20 lines, and its wrap-only wording differs from the sibling preview note
